verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly is a SaaS platform that ingests context attributes, evaluation events, session replays and AI run data, so data retention and deletion controls are a fair axis. The evidence pack has no documentation of retention windows, data deletion, or erasure controls. Expiring individual flag targeting (docs-48) and the change-history log (docs-53) are adjacent features, not data retention controls, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
